title: Megurine Luka — Doing Things My Own Way〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So this is her SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's so empty but...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: There are others here now.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I wonder where Miku is.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (There's nothing as far as I can tell, but there are people here.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (I suppose this place is a reflection of her feelings...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Someone's singing...
Is that...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Found you...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, Luka...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You're here too, Luka...?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. I see you as well, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah. MEIKO's here too.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, I see.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But if you take away Miku, I've been here the longest. I can show you around if you really want...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: No, that's fine.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Are you sure about that...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. I'll be fine.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe.You require so much attention, Rin...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Since that's the case, I'll bite. Okay, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Forget it...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, did I rub you the wrong way?
You're acting like children.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Just when I sensed that someone was still here.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. As Rin might say, You can join our little conversation if you really want, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's not how I really talk.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh? Are you sure about that?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Whose side are you on, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Sides? No, I'm not on anyone's side. Let me just say this...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Your cheap taunts won't work on me.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
But now I understand.
This is what you're actually like.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Likewise.
I seem to understand now as well.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The way we think and do things just aren't compatible.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, I agree with you there.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: She's gone...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You're not exactly working together, I see?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah. MEIKO tries not to go anywhere near Mafuyu or the others. She's just been keeping them at arm's length.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And she just wanders around this SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh? Why's that?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I don't know...
But I believe she's looking for something.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: All by herself no less.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I suppose we really are incompatible.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What are you planning to do, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Talk to her. To the one whose feelings created this SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, I almost forgot. There are others that can come here as they please, no?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'll talk to them too while I'm at it.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to seeing what they're all like.
